name: AnnualWellnessVisit
title: Annual Wellness Visit
description: Health risk assessment completed by adults 65 and over before their annual wellness visit.

extension.valueMarkdown: Covers the health risk assessment topics of a Medicare annual wellness visit. The clinician reviews it with the patient.

item.text: This yearly check-in helps you and your care team plan how to keep you healthy and independent. A family member or caregiver may help you fill it in.
In general, how would you rate your health?

valueCoding.display: At home, with a spouse or partner

item.text: Is someone helping you fill in this form?
Other doctors or clinics you see
For example a cardiologist, eye doctor or physical therapist.
Do you need help from another person with…
Getting in or out of a bed or chair
Getting to places beyond walking distance
If you need help, do you get the help you need?
On how many days a week are you physically active for at least 30 minutes?
Have you fallen in the past year?
Do you feel unsteady when standing or walking?
Your care team will talk with you about ways to prevent falls.
Which of these do you have at home?
Has anyone worried about your driving?
Do you feel safe at home?
If you do not feel safe at home, please tell your care team. We can help.
Do you have trouble hearing, even with a hearing aid?
Do you use a hearing aid?
Do you have trouble seeing, even with glasses?
Have you, or someone close to you, noticed changes in your memory or thinking?
Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
Little interest or pleasure in doing things

code.display: Little interest or pleasure in doing things in last 2 weeks
Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless in last 2 weeks

extension.valueMarkdown: A score of 3 or more is a positive depression screen: follow up with the PHQ-9.

How many prescription medicines do you take?
